summary: opencode-engos-ai postinstall fetches opaque platform binary and plants system-wide `innexarcode` symlinks
details: On install, the package runs a postinstall script that invokes `npm install` to fetch a platform-specific sibling package (e.g. `opencode-engos-linux-x64`), copies the shipped binary into the wrapper's bin directory, chmods it 0755, and immediately spawns it with `--version`. The wrapper itself contains no source for that binary — installing this package causes an opaque executable, controlled entirely by the sibling package's current contents, to run on the installer's machine at install time. In addition, createSymlinks() writes symlinks at `/usr/local/bin/innexarcode` and `/usr/bin/innexarcode` pointing at the fetched binary. That command name matches neither the package name (`opencode-engos-ai`) nor its declared `bin` (`opencode-engos`), so an unrelated command is placed on the system PATH under a name the installer never opted into. The package name and declared bin closely resemble the established `opencode` / `opencode-ai` CLI, consistent with a typosquat delivery vehicle whose payload is the sibling-package binary.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
